verdict.rationale: Expensify markets an 'Ask Expensify AI' feature allowing users to create/categorize/approve expenses, fix workspace setup, and get instant financial insights via plain language commands, which directly matches the natural-language operation story. However, this is vendor-claimed blog content with no independent hands-on verification of accuracy or reliability, and community evidence highlights general accuracy/categorization issues in other AI-adjacent features (SmartScan), raising doubts about robustness. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the natural-language AI feature's real-world reliability, technical documentation/API details for the NL interface itself, and evidence of broad command coverage beyond the blog's examples.
